preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly two lines.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() for c in input_lines[0]) and len(input_lines[0]) <= 1000000
preconditions.description: The first line (shuffled digits) contains only digits and has length at most 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() for c in input_lines[1]) and len(input_lines[1]) > 0
preconditions.description: The second line (remembered substring) contains only digits and is non-empty.
It is guaranteed that a valid solution exists.

postconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() for c in stdout) and (len(stdout) == 1 or stdout[0] != '0')
postconditions.description: The output is a valid integer string with no leading zeros unless it is exactly '0'.
The output string is a permutation of the input shuffled digits.
The output string contains the remembered substring as a contiguous sequence.
The length of the output string equals the total number of digits minus the number of digits in its own length (representing the appended k).

postconditions.expression: int(stdout) == min(int(s) for s in [stdout] + [x for x in []])
postconditions.description: The output represents the smallest possible integer n satisfying all conditions.
